categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Tianyuan Dike Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in software and information technology services, ICT product sales, and value-added services. Its main business segments include telecommunications industry BOSS systems, financial IT services and outsourcing, government and enterprise digital solutions, and ICT product distribution through subsidiaries. The company serves communication operators, financial institutions, government agencies, and large enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing, IoT, and information security. It develops proprietary AI platforms including large model integration, intelligent cloud platforms, and AI-native applications. The company emphasizes software development, system integration, and digital transformation solutions, with a focus on AI-driven intelligent operations and multi-modal data processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major Chinese telecom operators (China Telecom, China Unicom, China Mobile), state-owned and joint-stock banks, insurance companies, government departments, and large enterprises. The company’s financial IT services cater to banks and insurance firms, while its telecom solutions support operators’ digital transformation. ICT product sales target government and enterprise clients, including partnerships with Huawei, Super Fusion, and DJI.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a presence in major regions including Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Beijing, Shanghai, Hefei, Wuhan, and other provincial capitals. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Macau, and overseas markets. Its sales and service network covers eastern, western, southern, northern, and central China, with some international exposure.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Tianyuan Dike functions mainly as a midstream and downstream player in the IT and telecommunications supply chain. It develops and sells software products, provides IT services and system integration, and acts as a general distributor for ICT hardware products. It also offers value-added services and business process outsourcing, positioning itself close to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI-driven innovation, focusing on large model AI integration, intelligent cloud platforms, AI-native applications, and data security. It invests heavily in R&D to develop AI-powered solutions for telecom, finance, and government sectors. Key projects include AI one-stop development platforms, intelligent solution generation, data security unified platforms, and intelligent recognition systems. The company also emphasizes talent development and cross-industry collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through software product sales, customized software development, technical services, system integration projects, ICT product sales, and value-added services. The company also earns income from telecom operation business revenue sharing and financial IT outsourcing services. Its ICT product sales include hardware distribution with after-sales support, while service revenues come from consulting, implementation, and ongoing operational support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the telecom BOSS system market with over 20 years of experience and a strong foothold in financial IT services and government digital solutions. It competes with other domestic IT service providers and telecom software vendors, leveraging its AI capabilities and extensive client base. Its subsidiary, Jinhuawei, is a top distributor for Huawei and DJI products, enhancing its competitive edge in ICT product sales.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.16 billion, a 23.84% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 23.2 million, a decrease of 18.10%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.68 billion, growing 8.67%. It has a sizable R&D investment of RMB 342 million, representing 4.19% of revenue. The company’s cash flow from operations improved significantly, indicating enhanced operational quality.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes enabling digital transformation through AI-powered intelligent solutions tailored for telecom, finance, and government sectors. Its competitive differentiation lies in its proprietary AI technology stack, integration of large AI models, comprehensive intelligent cloud platforms, and strong industry-specific expertise. It offers standardized yet customizable software products and services, supported by a broad ecosystem partnership network, delivering high-value, innovative, and secure digital solutions.
